verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.agentmail.to (HTTP 200, AgentMail documentation header). The docs are served as markdown pages and include agent-targeted material: a self-signup quickstart for agents and an installable skills pack for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the docs successfully, and no evidence of how deep the llms.txt index goes (e.g., a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For agents that sign themselves up programmatically, no Console or dashboard needed.
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
